skill.name: cargo-context
skill.description: Manage Cargo workspace go-to-market knowledge through typed Markdown documents, repository edits, sandbox inspection, and knowledge-graph queries.
skill.summary: Maintain buyer personas, positioning, plays, proof points, and source links in a Cargo workspace knowledge base.
skill.author: getcargohq

security_audit.summary: Documentation links, Markdown backticks, quoted heredocs, and workspace identity checks account for most alerts; no evidence found of malicious injection or exfiltration. Twelve temporary-file findings retain conditional overwrite, disclosure, or tampering risks on shared hosts. The bootstrap recipe also lacks per-file checks to enforce its promise not to overwrite existing knowledge.

remediation.issue: Predictable temporary files can be replaced, shared across runs, or exposed through permissive file modes.
remediation.suggestion: Use mktemp -d with umask 077 for all snapshots and enrichment results. Keep reads in that private directory and remove it after use.

remediation.issue: Bootstrap uses an overwrite-capable write command without verifying each generated destination is absent.
remediation.suggestion: Inventory each target folder and check every destination before writing. Skip existing paths and use an atomic create-only API where available.

content.user_title: Manage Your Cargo GTM Knowledge Base
content.value_statement: Scattered buyer knowledge makes positioning and sales guidance difficult to maintain. This skill organizes Cargo workspace documents and connects personas, plays, objections, and evidence.
actual_capabilities: Browse workspace context folders and read complete documents or selected line ranges.
Create or overwrite typed Markdown entries and apply exact substring edits through Cargo CLI.
Inspect sandbox files with commands such as grep, ls, and pwd.
Query knowledge graphs for domain coverage, unresolved references, and plays without supporting proof.
Guide public-source bootstrap using company enrichment, cited research, and domain templates.
Guide human-reviewed updates from sales calls using repetition thresholds and source references.
limitations: Requires Cargo CLI authentication, a configured context repository, and appropriate workspace permissions.
Write and edit operations push immediately to the default branch; there is no dry-run mode.
Graph response fields are illustrative, frontmatter is not validated, and cached results can lag behind writes.
Bootstrap enrichments require available integrations and may consume credits; actual ICP discovery requires separate analysis.

use_cases.title: Maintain Buyer Personas
use_cases.description: Document buyer roles, pains, preferred channels, and supporting objections using consistent templates and source links.

use_cases.title: Refresh Sales Guidance
use_cases.description: Review call-derived claims individually, propose evidence-backed updates, and check related plays for missing proof.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Workspaces
use_cases.description: Confirm the client workspace, research its public domain, and draft missing company context before approved repository writes.

prompt_templates.title: Explore Existing Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Browse my Cargo context and summarize existing personas, positioning, and plays. Do not change any files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: understand the current knowledge base.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Buyer Persona
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the persona template and draft a persona for [role] using [approved notes]. Confirm the workspace and request approval before writing.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Knowledge Links
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the knowledge graph for unresolved references and plays without proof. Verify the response shape and propose fixes without editing files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review coverage and document relationships.

prompt_templates.title: Bootstrap a Client Workspace
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a bootstrap plan for [domain]. Confirm the workspace, estimate integration credits, cite sources, and skip existing paths. Request approval before writes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: coordinate research and controlled repository updates.

output_examples.input: Summarize our current Cargo context without making changes.
output: Illustrative inventory: company positioning, two buyer personas, and one outbound play are documented.
One play has no supporting proof link.

output_examples.input: Draft a Head of RevOps persona from approved notes.
output: Responsibilities: GTM systems, data quality, and pipeline reporting.
Evidence: approved notes linked through source references.
Workspace confirmation and approval are required before writing.

output_examples.input: Plan a bootstrap from our company domain.
output: Illustrative plan: draft company positioning, one customer segment, and two buyer personas from cited public sources.
Check each proposed destination and skip existing entries.
Review integration availability and credit costs before research.
Approve the draft files before repository writes.

best_practices: Confirm the workspace and review proposed changes before any write or edit because commits push immediately.
Read domain templates, preserve frontmatter, and use supported source links that resolve to existing files.
Review call-derived claims individually and apply repetition thresholds; keep local snapshots in private temporary directories.
anti_patterns: Write into an ambiguous client workspace or assume repository changes are local drafts.
Promote unsupported research claims or bulk-apply sales-call conclusions without human review.
Assume domain-level bootstrap checks prevent filename collisions or that bare source paths create graph edges.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Cargo operations also require the Cargo CLI and an authenticated workspace.

faq.question: What must be configured first?
faq.answer: Install Cargo CLI, authenticate, and confirm the intended workspace has a context repository and suitable permissions.

faq.question: Do writes remain local until deployment?
faq.answer: No. Write and edit operations commit and push immediately to the default branch. Sandbox execute operations do not push changes.

faq.question: Does this skill discover our ideal customers?
faq.answer: It documents approved conclusions and can guide public-source seeding. Deriving actual buyer segments from won and lost deals requires separate analysis.

faq.question: How are source references connected in the graph?
faq.answer: Use frontmatter references, Markdown links, or wikilinks to existing files. Bare paths in prose do not create graph edges.

faq.question: What safety precautions are needed?
faq.answer: Confirm the workspace, approve changes, and check destination paths before bootstrap writes. Protect temporary files and review integration permissions and costs.
